title: Ext kernel-image exactness at a covariant boundary
statement: Let C be an abelian category with small Ext groups [def-sp-abelian], X an object, and S a short exact sequence 0→S.X₁→S.X₂→S.X₃→0 [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For n≥0, if y∈Extⁿ(X,S.X₃) has Yoneda product zero with the extension class of S, then there exists z∈Extⁿ(X,S.X₂) whose product with the degree-zero class of S.g is y.

lemma covariant_sequence_exact₃ {n₀ : ℕ} (x₃ : Ext X S.X₃ n₀) {n₁ : ℕ} (hn₁ : n₀ + 1 = n₁)
    (hx₃ : x₃.comp hS.extClass hn₁ = 0) :
    ∃ (x₂ : Ext X S.X₂ n₀), x₂.comp (mk₀ S.g) (add_zero n₀) = x₃
